locator.section: The Most Holy Name of Jesus, Secret body

entries.claim: Historical English basis of the Secret body, revised against the Latin in contemporary language: most merciful, by which every creature lives, this sacrifice of ours, for Your praise and the contemporary address. This page abbreviates the conclusion as Through the same, &c.

locator.section: Libera nos, expanded conclusion said in a low voice

entries.claim: Historical basis for the silent part of the expanded conclusion through God, revised for the selected Latin: same is retained and our is supplied for nostrum; address and Holy Spirit terminology are modernized. The audible ending is a separate segment.
